output.summary: The rise in admitted-patient ED length of stay is almost entirely boarding (about 3.0 of 3.2 h). Boarding jumped in March, when the hospitalist rounding change moved medical-ward discharge orders from 11:50 to 15:25. Surgical wards did not change. Bed capacity and occupancy are flat, ED volume is comparable, and ED RN hours per visit and vacancy are flat or better, so understaffing is contradicted. The 4 West huddle pilot looks near-experimental (schedule set in advance, comparable days, no spillover) and halved boarding. The evening bed-cleaning cut began in September and has no turnaround data. The front-end metrics worsened after the triage-provider cut on 1 May, which confounds the boarding link. Extend the huddle. Do not buy travel nurses or pause the 4 West huddle.
